name: fb-screenshot-none-m
title: Screenshot · nothing attached
note: A file the fan picks, never an automatic capture. The checkbox row becomes an attach row; tapping it opens the photo or file picker.

name: fb-screenshot-attached-m
title: Screenshot · attached
note: Thumbnail, file name and size, and × to remove (36px, 44px hit area). Picking again replaces it.

name: fb-screenshot-wrong-type-m
title: Screenshot · wrong file type
note: The file is refused and not shown. Live copy. The error clears when the fan picks again.

name: fb-send-failed-m
title: Send failed
note: The form stays as the fan left it, with the banner just above the buttons. Try again resends; Save and come back closes the sheet with the draft kept.

name: fb-draft-restored-m
title: Opened again · draft restored
note: Kind, text and screenshot come back. Discard draft clears it on the spot.

name: fb-validation-nothing-m
title: Validation · no kind, no message
note: Send is never disabled. Pressing it marks each missing field and focuses the first.

name: fb-validation-venue-m
title: Validation · Suggest a venue, no name
note: Replaces “Send stays off” on the addendum 3 empty board.

name: fb-kind-idea-m
title: An idea
note: Same box, its own label and hint. The others are in the table above.

name: fb-broken-d
title: Desktop · Something’s broken, screenshot attached
note: Every kind uses the same 520px modal.

name: fb-sent-d
title: Desktop · sent
note: One sent state for every kind.

name: fb-what-we-send-m
title: What we send with it · open
note: Closed by default, one quiet line above Send. Opens in place.
